---
name: "MediaWiki net: GitHub's renderer does the math"
about: Compute a tiny neural net in MediaWiki markup on your text and update the profile animation
title: "mediawiki: example text"
---

This will write your text into a **MediaWiki page that GitHub's own renderer computes** with a tiny neural net, and update the animation at the top of the profile with the result.

Replace `example text` in the title above with letters, spaces and basic punctuation (up to about 55 characters). You can leave this box as is.
